references.zhao-jurafsky-2005: Zhao, Y., & Jurafsky, D. (2005). A preliminary study of Mandarin filled pauses. Proceedings of DiSS'05, 177-180. https://nlp.stanford.edu/pubs/diss05.pdf (Mandarin uses nage 'that' and zhege 'this' as lexical fillers beside the mm filled pause.)
references.liu-2009: Liu, B. (2009). Chinese discourse markers in oral speech of mainland Mandarin speakers. Proceedings of NACCL-21, 2, 358-374. (Nage and zhege serve as verbal fillers while the speaker searches for a word.)
references.xiandai-2016: Institute of Linguistics, Chinese Academy of Social Sciences (Ed.). (2016). 现代汉语词典 (7th ed.). 商务印书馆. Entry 嗯 as an interjection.
